predicate shift_preserve(orig: list[option[int]], idx: int, shifted: list[option[int]]) {
    (((len(orig) == (len(shifted) + 1)) ∧
        (∀(i: int) ::
            ((0 <= i < idx) ==>
                (shifted[i] == orig[i])))) ∧
        (∀(i: int) ::

                (shifted[i] == orig[(i + 1)]))))
}
